title: Composing with a monomorphism gives a monomorphism of cokernels
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], let $v:c\to p$ be a morphism and $j:p\to q$ a monomorphism of $\mathcal A$. Let $\pi_v:p\to\operatorname{Coker}(v)$ and $\pi_{jv}:q\to\operatorname{Coker}(j\circ v)$ be cokernels. Then the unique morphism $\bar\jmath:\operatorname{Coker}(v)\to\operatorname{Coker}(j\circ v)$ with $\bar\jmath\circ\pi_v=\pi_{jv}\circ j$ (it exists since $\pi_{jv}\circ j\circ v=0$) is a monomorphism.
